description: Ending a meeting closes open speaking requests.

preconditions: Meeting with one Queued, one Invited and one Speaking request.
Caller holds the meeting transaction and lock.
cases.return: The Speaking turn becomes Finished and the other two become Cancelled, all with EndedAt = endedAt; the ending itself publishes no speaking change (readers reload on the meeting-ended notice).

preconditions: Meeting with no open requests (only Finished and Cancelled ones).
Caller holds the meeting transaction and lock.
cases.return: Nothing is closed and no row changes.

preconditions: Meeting with an open request raised under a guest invitation.
Caller holds the meeting transaction and lock.
cases.return: The guest request is closed like any member request (Cancelled while Queued or Invited, Finished while Speaking).
